title: Embedding into a quasi-coherent module pushed forward from an affine cover
statement: Let X be a quasi-compact scheme over a field k with affine diagonal [def-weil-field] [def-pc-scheme], and F a quasi-coherent O_X-module [pqf-def-coherent]. There exist an affine scheme U, an affine morphism j: U → X, a quasi-coherent O_U-module G, and a monomorphism F → j_*G. This is the geometric construction only, without a cohomological vanishing assertion.

source.place: Tag 0BDY, proof of Lemma 30.4.3 (1), finite affine cover and stalk-injective adjunction unit; verified at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BDY

proof.text: Set C to X.affineCover.finiteSubcover, using quasi-compactness. Each C.X i is affine. Set U to the actual finite coproduct of C.X and j to Sigma.desc C.f. The finite affine coproduct instance gives IsAffine U, including the empty cover case.

For each i and affine open V in X, use Hom.isAffineOpen_iff_of_isOpenImmersion to identify affineness of its preimage with affineness of (C.f i).opensRange inf V. Apply isAffineHom_diagonal_iff to the given relative diagonal and the top affine open of Spec k. Thus every component C.f i is affine. The existing proved isAffineHom_sigmaDesc uses the finite disjoint union of these affine preimages to show that j is affine.

Open immersions are flat. The existing flat-cover reflection theorem, specialized to C.f and C.covers, shows that the pullback functors jointly reflect isomorphisms. Transfer this statement to the restriction functors through restrictFunctorIsoPullback. Restriction preserves equalizers, and Mathlib JointlyReflectIsomorphisms.jointlyFaithful therefore makes this family jointly faithful.

Pullback along each C.f i is naturally isomorphic to pullback along j followed by pullback along Sigma.ι C.X i, using Sigma.ι_desc, pullbackCongr and pullbackComp. An equality after pullback along j thus gives equal restrictions on all cover members, and joint faithfulness gives the original equality. Hence pullback along j is faithful.

Set G to the actual functor value (Modules.pullback j).obj F. Pullback preserves quasi-coherence. Take i to be (Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction j).unit.app F; Mathlib Adjunction.unit_mono_of_L_faithful gives Mono i. Assemble U, j, G and these witnesses to prove the unchanged existential statement.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_affine_cover_module_embedding (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u})
    [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [CompactSpace X]
    [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))]
    (F : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) [F.IsQuasicoherent] :
    ∃ (U : Scheme.{u}) (j : U ⟶ X)
      (G : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toRingedSpace)),
      IsAffine U ∧ IsAffineHom j ∧ G.IsQuasicoherent ∧
        ∃ i : F ⟶ (Modules.pushforward j).obj G, Mono i
